headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona, Real Madrid scout Erling Haaland at Anfield
description: Barcelona and Real Madrid continue to keep tabs on Erling Haaland, while Chelsea growing confident of signing Bournemouth's Alex Scott. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Unai Emery keen for Aston Villa to use home advantage in Fenerbahce clash
description: Aston Villa boss Unai Emery wants his side to enjoy their home comforts once again when they host Fenerbahce in the Champions League.

headline: Liverpool's Alexander Isak, Cody Gakpo, Dominik Szoboszlai to miss Champions League clash with LASK
description: Liverpool are set to be without Alexander Isak, Cody Gakpo and Dominik Szoboszlai for Wednesday's UEFA Champions League clash with LASK.

headline: Enzo Maresca on Man City celebration at Anfield: 'What do you want us to do?'
description: Enzo Maresca has hit back at criticism of Manchester City's celebrations at Anfield on Sunday by saying: "What do you want us to do?"

headline: Man United could never contend for the Premier League title -- but they aren't so bad either
description: Man United fans go from thinking the team will win the Premier League to thinking the sky is falling. The truth is in the middle and it's unlikely to shift.

headline: Premier League overreactions: Takeaways from first games post-international break
description: After a three-week intermission, the Premier League returned with a bang last weekend. Will Man City eventually crumble under the pressure? Is this the real Man United? Let's overreact!
